text:
alex: Heads up — planning to run the users.addresses schema migration + backfill next Wed 03:00 UTC. Need owner for the migration run, a smoke checklist, and rollback readiness. Who can take the lead?

sara: I can lead the migration run if @vincent or @maria can own pre/post smoke checks. timing ok?

vincent: i'm good for pre-smoke. will validate connectivity, read replicas, and run the quick counts before switching.

maria: i'll do post-smoke + basic data verification after backfill completes. can write a short checklist.

alex: thanks. owner for DB-side rollback plan? we should confirm dual-write window and how long it stays on.

vincent: rollback plan: stop backfill, revert application feature flag to read-from-old, and run a corrective sync job if needed. need to confirm that old write path is still hot for 2h post-cutover.

jordan: @alex remind me — who will hold the feature-flag toggle? ops-oncall or infra?

ops-oncall: ops team can hold the toggle and be ready to flip. please add runbook steps in the deploy playbook.

infra-bot: Deploy window reservation confirmed for 2028-03-15 03:00 UTC -> 05:30 UTC (2.5h) by infra team.

alex: dual-write window proposal: 30 minutes of dual-write then monitor for 1h, then cut traffic. anyone object?

vincent: 30 min sounds reasonable. i will watch replication lag and KV cache metrics. if lag > 500ms or error rate spikes, we abort and rollback.

maria: post-checks i'll run: sample queries (row counts), sample reads on both paths, and a small subset of user flows through QA. will post results in thread.

sara: pre-check checklist i want: snapshot of schema, run EXPLAIN on the migration scritpt, verify replicas, make DB dump of affected table, ensure run-transaction timeout is set to 10m.

alex: add a quick smoke command to the playbook:

```
-- smoke checks
SELECT count(*) FROM users.addresses WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
SELECT pg_last_wal_replay_lsn(); -- check replica lag
curl -sfS https://health.example.com/internal/address-service/ready
```

alex: Also: who has permission to kick off the migration job (k8s job)? @sara?

sara: i'll trigger the job, but please add me to the runbook with escalation steps. i'll tag @ops-oncall for the toggle.

jordan: can we add an automated rollback hook if errors > 2% in first 15m? we can script a monitor that posts to this thread.

vincent: i can add a quick prometheus alert and a tiny lambda to watch error rates and post to slack channel. will attach the alert query to the runbook.

maria: timeline recap: 03:00 start migration job, 03:30 enable dual-write, 04:00 start monitoring window, 05:00 decision point for full cutover, 05:30 latest rollback deadline.

alex: perfect. i'll update the calendar invite and the deploy playbook with owners: @sara (runner), @vincent (pre-smoke + metrics), @maria (post-smoke), @ops-oncall (feature-flag toggle). please ack here once you've added runbook sections.

sara: ack, i'll add run steps and escalate matrix today.

vincent: ack — adding alerts and dashboards.

maria: ack — will prep verification script and sample queries.

ops-oncall: ack — will standby and confirm toggle access by EOD.

alex: thanks team. i'll post the final runbook link here when ready. :thumbsup:
